stories.title: Attempts to curb Ebola cases in DR Congo fail with more than 5,000 confirmed
stories.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing the biggest Ebola epidemic in its history. Government data showed on Tuesday that cases now exceed 5,000. Efforts to contain the deadly illness are being hampered by weak health infrastructure, community resistance and instability.

stories.title: Iran warns countries against 'assistance or facilitation' of US army
stories.summary: Iran warns countries against 'assistance or facilitation' of US army The Chief of Staff of Iran's Armed Forces has warned neighbouring countries from allowing the US to use their territories to launch attacks against Iran.  "The countries on the southern shores of the Persian Gulf, which have issued various statements declaring that they will not allow the United States to use their territories against Iran, should know that nothing is hidden from our eyes," Ali Abdollahi said in a statement carried by Iranian state media.  "Any assistance or facilitation to the aggressive US army is tantamount to participation with US military forces," he added.
